title: wss-guide: rate-limit 'per outbound connection' qualifier inconsistent
description: The server rate-limiting section says typing events are limited 'per sender per chat per 3 seconds, per outbound connection'. The client section describes the same limit but omits 'per outbound connection'. If that qualifier is meaningful (same typing event rate-limited differently per recipient connection), the client section should reflect it; if not, it should be removed from the server section.
